messages:
marta: :rotating_light: paging — EU API 5xx spike, TLS handshake failures reported from edge. Cloudflare edge TLS handshake timeouts + DNS resolution errors. Seeing customer 502/523s inbound. Anyone oncall?
incident-bot: Incident created (sev=2). Pager duty notified. Link: https://pd/reddo/INC-2793
pagerduty-bot: Pager duty escalation sent to oncall: chris -> kai -> owen.
chris: I’m oncall, looking now. Can folks paste the top errors from the logs?
kai: From ingress logs (filtered last 10m):
```
2026-03-15T12:05:17Z ingress: upstream_tls_handshake_timeout host=eu1.edge.cloudflare.net path=/v1/generate status=502
2026-03-15T12:06:03Z ingress: dns_resolution_failed host=eu1.edge.cloudflare.net err=NXDOMAIN
2026-03-15T12:06:47Z ingress: connection_refused host=eu1.edge.cloudflare.net err=handshake timeout
```
kai: Datadog traces show increased latency and a spike in TLS handshake errors originating from multiple EU PoPs (fra, ams, mad).
riya: Cloudflare status page shows "Partial service degradation in EU edge" for TLS/HTTP. Also seeing higher than normal 100ms+ handshake times on our synthetic monitors.
own: Observability vendor (log-ingest) is also delayed — logs arriving ~30s late, some spans dropped. So alerting was slower.
chris: Initial customer impact: Hosted API (eu region) request success rate down ~92% for last 18m, affecting webhooks and sync jobs. No customer data loss, but degraded availability.
kai: Mitigation plan: 1) divert EU traffic to fallback routing policy (bypass Cloudflare edge for critical API routes) 2) enable aggressive retry/backoff on client SDKs for 10m 3) open ticket with Cloudflare and standby for region update.
marta: Approved. Chris/Kai — coordinate failover. Owen — please posture comms + support. Riya — continue monitoring observability ingestion.
chris: Triggering routing change: running our control-plane API to set route policy for /v1/generate -> direct-origin-eu with sticky=false
```
POST /admin/routing/policies/override 200 OK
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "policy": "direct-origin-eu", "ttl": 600 }
```
chris: Policy applied, rolling. Sending gradual 10% -> 100% over 2 minutes to avoid origin surge.
kai: Observed immediate drop in TLS handshake errors for traffic hitting direct-origin. Edge failures still seen for requests still hitting Cloudflare — routing rollout in progress.
own: Support: escalating to customer success for high-value tenants in EU. Drafting status message for affected customers (in progress).
riya: Note: Datadog ingest backlog cleared at 12:30Z, but there are still gaps in traces between 12:04–12:12Z. We should capture internal metrics (nginx request counters) for postmortem.
marta: Good. Any other mitigation? Can we temporarily raise retry count for SDKs server-side header?
chris: Pushed header X-RI-Retry: 2 for internal routes, that should make clients retry quickly. Also increased gateway connection timeout to 12s.
kai: Cloudflare ticket ID created: CF-12345678. They acknowledge it may be an upstream handshake degradation tied to a routing table change in EU (they're investigating). ETA unknown.
own: Customer impact estimate: ~7% of total requests globally; concentrated EU region (~20% of EU customers experienced errors). Duration so far 18m and decreasing.
marta: Logging note: Save top 200 failed request IDs and captcha any PII. Chris, make sure logs are archived to S3 for postmortem.
chris: Archived logs to s3://redwood-incident-archives/2793000123/ . Also snapshot gateway pool sizes and queue lengths.
kai: Quick health check run: curl direct-origin-eu.redwood.ai/v1/health => 200 OK. curl via cloudflare edge still intermittently 523/502.
riya: Observability: spinning up fallback ingestion path to ensure we capture metrics for the remaining window.
own: Comms: Draft status update for customers — will send in 15m after we confirm stable routing.
marta: Action items: 1) Keep routing override until CF confirms fix. 2) Collect traces/logs for 30m beyond stabilization. 3) Postmortem owner: kai. 4) Follow-up with observability vendor for dropped spans.
chris: Rollout finished at 12:28Z — EU error rate down to 1.3% for critical routes. Will monitor for 60m.
kai: Cloudflare update at 12:45Z: "Mitigation applied in FRA PoP, ongoing propagation. Please continue to route traffic through fallback until confirmed stable."
riya: Confirming metrics: success_rate_eu = 99.1% over last 5m. Traces now largely complete.
own: Support note sent to CS and status page updated: "We experienced an intermittent third-party CDN/TLS degradation affecting EU requests. Routing fallback applied; majority services restored."
marta: Thanks team. We'll keep this thread open for postmortem. Add timeline and links to CF ticket and S3 archive.
chris: Adding link to runbook entry: https://internal.runbooks.redwood/infrastructure/cloudflare-fallback
kai: Postmortem checklist assigned. ETA draft available by EOD.
incident-bot: Incident (2793) status changed to "mitigated". Final severity: Sev2.
marta: Marking follow-ups: - Verify long-tail errors over 24h - Add synthetic monitor across multiple EU PoPs (more dense) - Evaluate automatic fallback thresholds to avoid manual overrides.
own: Thx. Closing live coordination channel in 10m. :thumbsup:
chris: +1 — will attach logs and timeline to the incident.
riya: Captured observability vendor incident IDs: OD-4492 (ingest lag). Will include in postmortem.
marta: Closing notes: No customer data compromised. Root cause likely 3rd party edge TLS/routing flaps. Postmortem will capture detection/alert gaps (observability delay) and automation opportunities.
